commands:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
mkdir -p "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench" "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep"
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[b]ench_latency.py' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm bench serve' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm serve' || true; docker rm -f lab-2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin/ray" stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker run --rm --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HF_HOME="/hf" -e HOME="/tmp" -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="/tmp/vllm-cache" -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/hf" -v "$HOME/inference-sim-lab:/lab" --entrypoint python3 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0 /lab/bench/probe_env.py
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker run -d --name lab-2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HF_HOME="/hf" -e HOME="/tmp" -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="/tmp/vllm-cache" -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/hf" -v "$HOME/inference-sim-lab:/lab" --entrypoint python3 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0 /lab/bench/bench_latency.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --shapes 1x16,1x32,1x64,1x128,1x256,1x512,1x1024,1x2048,1x4096 --decode 128 --warmup 2 --iters 5 --tp 1 --pp 1 --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-model-len 4352 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-num-seqs 64 --seed 0 --output /lab/runs/2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep/results.jsonl
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
n=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.static_batch.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); d=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.done.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$(docker ps -q --filter name=^lab-2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep$)" ]; then a=1; else a=0; fi; if [ "${d:-0}" -ge 1 ] && [ "${n:-0}" -ge 9 ]; then c=1; else c=0; fi; echo "complete=$c progress=${n:-0} alive=$a"
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker logs lab-2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep > "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep/bench.log" 2>&1
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[b]ench_latency.py' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm bench serve' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm serve' || true; docker rm -f lab-2026-10-01-qwen7b-prefill-token-sweep >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin/ray" stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LAB_EOF
